root_cause.text: The MCTP netlink response functions fail to zero-initialize the netlink message header structures (`ifaddrmsg`, `ndmsg`, and `rtmsg`), leading to an information leak of uninitialized kernel memory in the padding bytes of these structures.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `memset(hdr, 0, sizeof(*hdr))` to zero-initialize the headers in `mctp_fill_addrinfo` (device.c), `mctp_fill_neigh` (neigh.c), and `mctp_fill_rtinfo` (route.c) before their fields are populated.
